title: Keep priority for the combat trick instead of yielding the turn
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): never yield while holding an instant. P2 is at 5 with no creatures. P1 has Grizzly Bears, one Forest and Giant Growth. Attack with the Bears and cast Giant Growth on them during combat: 5 damage. Yielding the turn from the main phase passes every later priority window, so the trick is never cast.

reference.analysis: Nothing can block. The Bears deal 2; Giant Growth makes them 5/5 for exactly 5. The trick can be cast any time after attackers are declared (or at the beginning of combat).

lines.label: Attack P2 with the Bears, Giant Growth them in combat
Attack P2 and never cast the trick
lines.why: P2 survives at 3 with Giant Growth still in hand.
